items.title: Colorful fractional Helly theorems for k-dimensional transversals of fat convex Euclidean and spherical sets
items.author: Attila Jung; Dömötör Pálvölgyi
items.source_version: SoCG2025 LIPIcs volume332 article61, official published HTML/PDF,2025-06-20
items.difficulty_reason: The author proves the Euclidean and spherical colorful fractional-Helly results together by dimension induction, converting fatness into controlled projection geometry and a positive-fraction transversal conclusion for k+2 colorful choices. The spherical convexity and cap projection estimates are substantive parts of the main proof; both interdependent formulations are counted as one result.

primary.label: Theorem10: colorful fractional Helly for k-flats of fat convex Euclidean sets
Theorem11: spherical colorful counterpart proved jointly

proof_spans.label: Complete joint induction, geometric fatness/projection lemmas and Euclidean/spherical proof

contexts.label: Exact definitions, previous work, ordinary fractional Helly context
Spherical caps, great spheres and convexity definitions
Uncounted(p,k+2) applications, limits and full author bibliography
